# Introduction

Here collects code for the estimation of splicing speed and nuclear residence time, as well as 
related downstream analyses.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Data processing

All the TTseq data are mapped by Anke, and then I used bam file to run IRFinder v2.0 to quatify the
intron retention ratio and then use this ratio to calculate the intron half lives.

# Model to estimate the intron half lives

Since now we have three time point, I developed a new model to do so. Different from the pulse and
chase experiment from SLAM-seq, the intron retention ratio in TTseq includes the newly transcribed
transcript and old transcript. Therefore the intron retention ratio represents an average splicing
status for all the transcripts that generated within the 4sU labeled time.

For an individual RNA molecule, we assume that intron removal follows first-order kinetics. Let
(U(t)) denote the probability that an intron remains unspliced when the RNA molecule has age (t).
The change in (U(t)) is described by

$$\frac{dU(t)}{dt}=-kU(t)$$

where (k) is the intron-removal rate constant in units of *min*.

Assuming that the intron is initially unspliced,

$$U(0)=1$$

the solution is

$$U(t)=e^{-kt}$$

Thus, for a synchronized population of RNA molecules that all have the same molecular age (t), the
fraction remaining unspliced decreases exponentially.

However, cumulative TT-seq labeling does not produce a synchronized RNA population. During a
labeling period of duration (T), new RNA molecules are continuously synthesized. Therefore, a sample
collected after (T) minutes contains labeled RNAs with molecular ages ranging approximately from 0
to (T) minutes.

For example, a 60-minute labeling sample contains both:

relatively old RNAs synthesized near the beginning of the labeling period, and very young RNAs
synthesized shortly before sample collection.

Consequently, the observed intron-retention ratio is the average probability of remaining unspliced
across all RNA ages present in the labeling interval.

Assuming a constant transcription rate, RNA ages are approximately uniformly distributed between 0
and (T). The expected intron-retention ratio is therefore

$$IR(T)=\frac{1}{T}\int_0^T e^{-kt}dt$$

Evaluating the integral gives

$$IR(T)=\frac{1-e^{-kT}}{kT}$$

The apparent intron-removal half-life is calculated from the fitted rate constant (k) as

$$Half\ lives=\frac{\ln(2)}{k}$$

This approach is conceptually related to kinetic models developed for progressive metabolic
RNA-labeling experiments, in which newly synthesized RNA is continuously generated while unspliced
RNA is removed through first-order splicing kinetics

## Model assumptions

The simplified model assumes that:

- RNA synthesis is approximately constant during the labeling period.\

- Each newly synthesized intron is initially unspliced.

- Intron removal follows a single first-order process.\

- RNA degradation during the labeling interval is negligible relative to intron removal.\

- The measured intron-retention ratio approximates the fraction of labeled RNA molecules that retain
  the intron.\

```{r}
## Data loading
## IR_15
## load 15mins
path.irf <- "~/Desktop/Data/Julian_lab/TTseq_all/TT15min/irfinder_quant/"
all_file <- list.files(path.irf)

for (i in 1:3) {
    t <- read.table(paste0(path.irf, all_file[[i]], "/IRFinder-IR-dir.txt"),
               header = T)
    n <- sub("imb_koenig_2024_15_01_", "", all_file[[i]]) %>%
        sub(".cutadapt", "", .)
    t$time_min <- 15
    t$replicate <- sub(".*_", "", n)
    
    t$Intron_ID <- paste0(t$Chr,":", t$Start,"-", t$End, " ", t$Strand)
    
    if (i == 1) {
        IR_15 <- t[,c("Intron_ID", "time_min", "replicate", "IRratio", "IntronDepth")]
    } else {
        tmp <- t[,c("Intron_ID", "time_min", "replicate", "IRratio", "IntronDepth")]
        IR_15 <- rbind(IR_15, tmp)
    }
    
}
```

## Half lives estimation

While I estimate the HLs, I take the **IntronDepth** into account as the weight of data point for
the regression.

```{r}
## function to fit the half lives
continuous_ir <- function(time_min, k) {

  x <- k * time_min

  ## when k*time is very small，use Taylor expansion to avoid the error
  ifelse(
    x < 1e-7,
    1 - x / 2 + x^2 / 6,
    -expm1(-x) / x
  )
}

fit_one_intron <- function(
    dat,
    required_timepoints = c(15, 30, 60),
    min_intron_depth = 5,
    min_reps_per_time = 2,
    min_half_life = 0.1,
    max_half_life = 1000,
    weight_method = c("sqrt", "linear", "none")
) {

  weight_method <- match.arg(weight_method)

  
  dat <- dat |>
    dplyr::ungroup() |>
    as.data.frame()
  ## keep raw data
  n_observations_raw <- nrow(dat)

  ## make sure the data type is correct
  dat <- dat |>
    mutate(
      time_min = as.numeric(time_min),
      replicate = as.character(replicate),
      IRratio = as.numeric(IRratio),
      IntronDepth = as.numeric(IntronDepth)
    )

  ## deplete un-wantted data
  dat_valid <- dat |>
    filter(
      is.finite(time_min),
      is.finite(IRratio),
      is.finite(IntronDepth),
      !is.na(replicate),
      time_min %in% required_timepoints,
      IRratio >= 0,
      IRratio <= 1,
      IntronDepth >= 0
    )

  ## based on introndepth filtered out the un-reliable data points
  dat_filtered <- dat_valid |>
    filter(
      IntronDepth >= min_intron_depth
    )

  n_filtered_low_depth <-
    nrow(dat_valid) - nrow(dat_filtered)

  n_observations_used <- nrow(dat_filtered)

  ## count how many data points still left after filtering
  reps_per_time <- dat_filtered |>
  dplyr::distinct(
    .data$time_min,
    .data$replicate
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(
    .data$time_min
  ) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_replicates = dplyr::n_distinct(
      .data$replicate
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

  all_timepoints_present <- all(
    required_timepoints %in% reps_per_time$time_min
  )

  min_reps_observed <- if (nrow(reps_per_time) > 0) {
    min(reps_per_time$n_replicates)
  } else {
    0
  }

  ## if there is missing timepoint or insufficiency data point then do not do the regression
  if (
    !all_timepoints_present ||
    min_reps_observed < min_reps_per_time
  ) {

    return(
      tibble(
        status = "insufficient_depth_or_replicates",
        n_observations_raw = n_observations_raw,
        n_observations_used = n_observations_used,
        n_filtered_low_depth = n_filtered_low_depth,
        min_reps_per_time = min_reps_observed,
        median_intron_depth = ifelse(
          n_observations_used > 0,
          median(dat_filtered$IntronDepth),
          NA_real_
        ),
        k_per_min = NA_real_,
        half_life_min = NA_real_,
        weighted_rmse = NA_real_,
        weighted_r_squared = NA_real_,
        boundary_fit = NA
      )
    )
  }

  ## weight intron depth
  dat_filtered <- dat_filtered |>
    mutate(
      raw_weight = case_when(
        weight_method == "sqrt" ~ sqrt(IntronDepth),
        weight_method == "linear" ~ IntronDepth,
        weight_method == "none" ~ 1
      ),

      ## normalization
      fit_weight = raw_weight / mean(raw_weight)
    )

  ## set the boundary for half lives
  lower_k <- log(2) / max_half_life
  upper_k <- log(2) / min_half_life

  lower_log_k <- log(lower_k)
  upper_log_k <- log(upper_k)

  ## fitting
  fit <- try(
    nlsLM(
      IRratio ~ continuous_ir(
        time_min,
        exp(log_k)
      ),
      data = dat_filtered,

      ## start with half-life = 15 min
      start = list(
        log_k = log(log(2) / 15)
      ),

      lower = c(
        log_k = lower_log_k
      ),

      upper = c(
        log_k = upper_log_k
      ),

      ## IntronDepth used as weigth to tell which data point is more reliable
      weights = fit_weight,

      control = nls.lm.control(
        maxiter = 1000
      )
    ),
    silent = TRUE
  )

  if (inherits(fit, "try-error")) {

    return(
      tibble(
        status = "fit_failed",
        n_observations_raw = n_observations_raw,
        n_observations_used = n_observations_used,
        n_filtered_low_depth = n_filtered_low_depth,
        min_reps_per_time = min_reps_observed,
        median_intron_depth =
          median(dat_filtered$IntronDepth),
        k_per_min = NA_real_,
        half_life_min = NA_real_,
        weighted_rmse = NA_real_,
        weighted_r_squared = NA_real_,
        boundary_fit = NA
      )
    )
  }

  ## get parameter log k
  log_k <- coef(fit)[["log_k"]]
  k <- exp(log_k)

  half_life_min <- log(2) / k

  ## calculate predicted value and residual
  observed <- dat_filtered$IRratio
  predicted <- predict(fit)
  residuals <- observed - predicted
  weights <- dat_filtered$fit_weight

  ## Weighted RMSE
  weighted_rmse <- sqrt(
    sum(weights * residuals^2) /
      sum(weights)
  )

  ## Weighted R-squared
  weighted_mean <- sum(
    weights * observed
  ) / sum(weights)

  weighted_rss <- sum(
    weights * residuals^2
  )

  weighted_tss <- sum(
    weights *
      (observed - weighted_mean)^2
  )

  weighted_r_squared <- if (weighted_tss > 0) {
    1 - weighted_rss / weighted_tss
  } else {
    NA_real_
  }

  ## fitting boundary
  boundary_fit <-
    abs(log_k - lower_log_k) < 0.02 ||
    abs(log_k - upper_log_k) < 0.02

  tibble(
    status = "ok",
    n_observations_raw = n_observations_raw,
    n_observations_used = n_observations_used,
    n_filtered_low_depth = n_filtered_low_depth,
    min_reps_per_time = min_reps_observed,
    median_intron_depth =
      median(dat_filtered$IntronDepth),
    min_intron_depth_used =
      min(dat_filtered$IntronDepth),
    max_intron_depth_used =
      max(dat_filtered$IntronDepth),
    k_per_min = unname(k),
    half_life_min = unname(half_life_min),
    weighted_rmse = weighted_rmse,
    weighted_r_squared = weighted_r_squared,
    boundary_fit = boundary_fit
  )
}
```

```{r}
#| eval: false
#| include: true
min_intronDepth <- 5
intron_half_lives <- IR_all |>
  group_by(Intron_ID) |>
  group_modify(
    ~ fit_one_intron(
      dat = .x,
      min_intron_depth = min_intronDepth,
      weight_method = "sqrt"
    )
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
    as.data.frame(.)

saveRDS(intron_half_lives, "rds/intron_half_lives_3_timepoint_weighted_3_reps.rds")

intron_half_lives_f <- intron_half_lives[!is.na(intron_half_lives$half_life_min),]
## make gr
intron_half_lives_f$start <- getstr(intron_half_lives_f$Intron_ID, ":", 1, "-",1)
intron_half_lives_f$end <- getstr(intron_half_lives_f$Intron_ID, "-", 1, " ",1)
intron_half_lives_f$seqnames <- sub(":.*", "", intron_half_lives_f$Intron_ID)
intron_half_lives_f$strand <- sub(".* ", "", intron_half_lives_f$Intron_ID)
gr_intron_hl_3 <- makeGRangesFromDataFrame(intron_half_lives_f, keep.extra.columns = T)

saveRDS(gr_intron_hl_3, "rds/gr_intron_HLs_3_timepoint_3_reps.rds")
```


```{r}
## data loading
gr_intron_hl_3 <- readRDS("rds/gr_intron_HLs_3_timepoint_3_reps.rds")
## filtering
gr_intron_hl_3 <- gr_intron_hl_3[gr_intron_hl_3$weighted_rmse <= 0.1]
## remove the intron with upper limited HLs
gr_intron_hl_3 <- gr_intron_hl_3[gr_intron_hl_3$half_life_min < max(gr_intron_hl_3$half_life_min)]

## move 1nt dut to the 0based coordinate from IRFinder
start(gr_intron_hl_3) <- start(gr_intron_hl_3)+1

m6A_mature_f <- 
    readRDS("../02 m6A deposition before splicing/rds/m6A_mature_f_with_chr_accessibility.rds")

m6A_mature_f$test_start <- m6A_mature_f$exon_start

m6A_mature_f$test_end <- m6A_mature_f$exon_end

## start
test_start <- data.frame(ID = m6A_mature_f$ID,
                         chr = seqnames(m6A_mature_f),
                         start = m6A_mature_f$test_start,
                         end = m6A_mature_f$test_start,
                         strand = strand(m6A_mature_f)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(start)) %>%
    makeGRangesFromDataFrame(., keep.extra.columns = T)

test_start$hl_SS <- gr_intron_hl_3$half_life_min[
    findOverlaps((test_start+10), gr_intron_hl_3, select = "first")]

## end
test_end <- data.frame(ID = m6A_mature_f$ID,
                         chr = seqnames(m6A_mature_f),
                         start = m6A_mature_f$test_end,
                         end = m6A_mature_f$test_end,
                         strand = strand(m6A_mature_f)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(start)) %>%
    makeGRangesFromDataFrame(., keep.extra.columns = T)

## load splicing speed data
test_end$hl_SS <- gr_intron_hl_3$half_life_min[
    findOverlaps((test_end+10), gr_intron_hl_3, select = "first")]


m6A_mature_f$hl_SS_start <- test_start$hl_SS[
    match(m6A_mature_f$ID, test_start$ID)
]
m6A_mature_f$hl_SS_end <- test_end$hl_SS[
    match(m6A_mature_f$ID, test_end$ID)
]

m6A_mature_f$hl_SS_mean <- rowMeans(mcols(m6A_mature_f)[, c("hl_SS_start", "hl_SS_end")] %>%
                                          as.data.frame(.),
                                      na.rm = T)
m6A_mature_f$bin_ss_hls <- cut(m6A_mature_f$hl_SS_mean, breaks = c(0,5,20,60,Inf))
```

```{r}
o <- findOverlaps(m6A_tt, gr_intron_hl_3, select = "first")

m6A_tt$intron_hl <- gr_intron_hl_3$half_life_min[o]
m6A_tt$intron_id <- gr_intron_hl_3$Intron_ID[o]

m6A_tt$bin_ss_hls <- cut(m6A_tt$intron_hl, breaks = c(0,10,20,30,60,Inf))
m6A_tt$seq5 <- getSeq(Hsapiens, m6A_tt+2)

p <- ggplot(as.data.frame(m6A_tt[!is.na(m6A_tt$bin_ss_hls)]), 
       aes(x = bin_ss_hls, y = mean_A2A_dmso)) + 
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) + 
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0,1)) + 
    labs(y = "m6A stoichiometry in nascent RNA",
         x = "Intron half lives")

gt <- fix_panel_size(p, panel_width = panel_width, panel_height = panel_height)
```

# Intron HLs QC

```{r}
gr_intron_hl_3 <- gr_intron_hl_3[seqnames(gr_intron_hl_3) %in% standardChromosomes(gr_intron_hl_3)]
gr_intron_hl_3$intron_length <- width(gr_intron_hl_3)
gr_intron_hl_3$seq <- getSeq(Hsapiens, gr_intron_hl_3)
gr_intron_hl_3$G_number <- str_count(as.character(gr_intron_hl_3$seq), "G")
gr_intron_hl_3$C_number <- str_count(as.character(gr_intron_hl_3$seq), "C")
gr_intron_hl_3$GC_number <- gr_intron_hl_3$G_number + gr_intron_hl_3$C_number
gr_intron_hl_3$GC_content <- gr_intron_hl_3$GC_number/gr_intron_hl_3$intron_length

## splice motif
gr_intron_hl_3$s_motif <- sapply(as.character(gr_intron_hl_3$seq), function(x) {
  n <- nchar(x)                 # string length
  if (n >= 4) {
    paste0(substr(x, 1, 2), substr(x, n-1, n))
  } else {
    NA   # return NA if string is too short
  }
})


gr_intron_hl_3$hl_bins <- cut(gr_intron_hl_3$half_life_min, breaks = c(0,10,20,30,60,Inf))
# saveRDS(gr_intron_hl_3,"rds/intron_HL_new.rds")
```
